claims.claim: The explicit prospective API remains on RuntimeCompletion and the original ExecutorBoundary. Default dispatch and terminal ownership remain unchanged.

Consumption retains fresh authentication of current admission, committed candidate, reviewed mandatory coverage, latest immutable K_i/F_i and original captures before exposure, after confirmation and on replay.

Local consumption requires the original registry holder, lease object, adapter, Runtime owner, thread and active native invocation. Detached, released, substituted and reconstructed holders cannot establish liveness.

The receipt binds authenticated K_i/F_i and protected Runtime/invocation identities. Only the original adapter's direct typed confirmation establishes local acknowledgment; production delivery and continuation remain unauthorized.
Exact replay reconciles retained immutable receipt bytes without another callback, proof execution or resource debit. Conflicting and ambiguous effects retain their original records and block.

Progress requires authenticated scoped committed descendant history, unchanged mandatory semantics and a strict reduction of original failed obligations. Continuation assessment remains STOP, including when progress is observed.

Missing finite Human opt-in and token accounting remain explicitly NOT_ESTABLISHED. Exhausted resources, source uncertainty and lease loss block without selecting consent, policy, budget or another Executor.

Existing terminal, mutation-fence, source-revocation and STOP guards prevent further acknowledgment or replay authority. Interrupted effects retain their immutable intent and cannot reconstruct a live invocation.
REPAIR and REMEDIATION consumption remain blocked from inheriting PRIMARY factual-feedback authority; caller correction labels cannot establish correction continuation.

Closed inspection schemas retain deterministic bounded encoding, canonical decoding and fixed non-actionable outputs. The adapter delegates to the original canonical validators without copying them or exposing lifecycle hooks.

Focused real-Git/native-proof and actual lease/boundary test definitions remain intact. Added isolated coverage checks cold-imported API references across explicit native binding, exact nested native types and rejection of malformed canonical input.

The committed repair touches only the three authorized files. Historical K_i/F_i types and callable APIs remain independently cold-importable, and the original VP-02B declarations retain their pure dependencies. Native inspection explicitly binds the existing canonical validators through Runtime and fails closed when unbound, preserving the original L3-01/02/03 native validation paths without hidden loading or reexports. Existing documentation retains L3-04 preactivation boundaries and separate L3-05, L3-06/G3, G6 and L4 obligations.
